g.title: Set Builder artifact database, collection sets (ml-store-artifact-db) – artifact-db at claude.ai artifact GcqZTGjk6obdpjWaU7WFRq; owner Markus via the page (only-you-write rule); concurrency: page writes queued one document at a time; init merges shared-wins-by-id with local-only uploads; weekly agent read-only

g.aria-label: Set Builder published files (ml-store-artifact-files) – artifact-files at claude.ai artifact GcqZTGjk6obdpjWaU7WFRq: index.html, app.js, assets/*, library.json; owner weekly agent (library.json), supervised rebuild (app.js); concurrency: publish refused unless read first; agent stops if live shell differs
g.title: Set Builder published files (ml-store-artifact-files) – artifact-files at claude.ai artifact GcqZTGjk6obdpjWaU7WFRq: index.html, app.js, assets/*, library.json; owner weekly agent (library.json), supervised rebuild (app.js); concurrency: publish refused unless read first; agent stops if live shell differs

g.aria-label: config (ml-store-config) – file at config/rules.json, config/sources.json; owner Markus (hand-edited; weekly agent must not edit thresholds); concurrency: none; read-only at run time
g.title: config (ml-store-config) – file at config/rules.json, config/sources.json; owner Markus (hand-edited; weekly agent must not edit thresholds); concurrency: none; read-only at run time

g.aria-label: data (ml-store-data) – folder at data/: metabrainz/ (canonical, json, postgres dumps, logs), metabrainz_scratch/ (inventory, slice, sql benches, tools, a MusicBrainz server git checkout mbs/, PROGRESS.md), ref_mb_pgdata/pgdata (Postgres cluster, postmaster.pid 2026-11-06); owner fetch_metabrainz.*, ref_mb scripts and compose, MB investigation agents; concurrency: Postgres owns pgdata; downloads resumable by size
g.title: data (ml-store-data) – folder at data/: metabrainz/ (canonical, json, postgres dumps, logs), metabrainz_scratch/ (inventory, slice, sql benches, tools, a MusicBrainz server git checkout mbs/, PROGRESS.md), ref_mb_pgdata/pgdata (Postgres cluster, postmaster.pid 2026-11-06); owner fetch_metabrainz.*, ref_mb scripts and compose, MB investigation agents; concurrency: Postgres owns pgdata; downloads resumable by size

g.aria-label: inbox (ml-store-inbox) – folder at inbox/; owner scrape, ingest, resolve, sync-tidal, weekly agent (artifact_sets.json), beatport agent (resolved/sync_result), Markus (manual_adds.csv); concurrency: date-keyed files, whole-file overwrite (dump_json); resolved_<date> is incremental (load, skip done keys, flush every 20). No lock between the Beatport agent and the weekly run writing the same resolved_/sync_result_<date> file.
g.title: inbox (ml-store-inbox) – folder at inbox/; owner scrape, ingest, resolve, sync-tidal, weekly agent (artifact_sets.json), beatport agent (resolved/sync_result), Markus (manual_adds.csv); concurrency: date-keyed files, whole-file overwrite (dump_json); resolved_<date> is incremental (load, skip done keys, flush every 20). No lock between the Beatport agent and the weekly run writing the same resolved_/sync_result_<date> file.

g.aria-label: DJ library ledger (ml-store-ledger) – file at ledger/dj_library_ledger.json (+ ledger/history/); owner run_weekly ingest/process/confirm; concurrency: single mutable JSON document (not append-only): write to .tmp then os.replace (atomic); process copies the old file to history/ledger_before_<date>.json first (overwritten if process re-runs the same date). No run lock; two runs would last-writer-win.
g.title: DJ library ledger (ml-store-ledger) – file at ledger/dj_library_ledger.json (+ ledger/history/); owner run_weekly ingest/process/confirm; concurrency: single mutable JSON document (not append-only): write to .tmp then os.replace (atomic); process copies the old file to history/ledger_before_<date>.json first (overwritten if process re-runs the same date). No run lock; two runs would last-writer-win.

g.aria-label: outputs (ml-store-outputs) – folder at outputs/<date>/, outputs/crates/, outputs/artifact/library.json, outputs/rekordbox_musicLibrary.xml; owner process, build_db, calibrate; concurrency: overwrite per run; deletes avoided on the synced drive (empty crates truncated)
g.title: outputs (ml-store-outputs) – folder at outputs/<date>/, outputs/crates/, outputs/artifact/library.json, outputs/rekordbox_musicLibrary.xml; owner process, build_db, calibrate; concurrency: overwrite per run; deletes avoided on the synced drive (empty crates truncated)

g.aria-label: overrides (ml-store-overrides) – folder at overrides/energy_overrides.csv, overrides/rekordbox_collection.xml (absent); owner Markus; concurrency: re-applied every process run; header only today
g.title: overrides (ml-store-overrides) – folder at overrides/energy_overrides.csv, overrides/rekordbox_collection.xml (absent); owner Markus; concurrency: re-applied every process run; header only today

g.aria-label: plan (ml-store-plan) – folder at plan/; owner prompt builders and launchers; concurrency: none
g.title: plan (ml-store-plan) – folder at plan/; owner prompt builders and launchers; concurrency: none

g.aria-label: ref_mb Postgres (ml-store-ref-mb) – postgres at 127.0.0.1:55433, data E:\musicLibrary\data\ref_mb_pgdata; owner ref_mb load scripts; concurrency: read-only role default_transaction_read_only=on; stop with -t 600
g.title: ref_mb Postgres (ml-store-ref-mb) – postgres at 127.0.0.1:55433, data E:\musicLibrary\data\ref_mb_pgdata; owner ref_mb load scripts; concurrency: read-only role default_transaction_read_only=on; stop with -t 600

g.aria-label: secrets (ml-store-secrets) – folder at secrets/ (tidal_app.json, tidal_user_token.json, tidal_pkce_pending.json, tidal_playlists.json); ref_mb/secrets/*.txt; owner tidal_cli, sync-tidal, sync-sets; Markus; concurrency: plain files, rewritten on refresh; pending cleared by writing {} (deletes blocked on synced drive). musicLibrary/secrets/ absent from this copy.
g.title: secrets (ml-store-secrets) – folder at secrets/ (tidal_app.json, tidal_user_token.json, tidal_pkce_pending.json, tidal_playlists.json); ref_mb/secrets/*.txt; owner tidal_cli, sync-tidal, sync-sets; Markus; concurrency: plain files, rewritten on refresh; pending cleared by writing {} (deletes blocked on synced drive). musicLibrary/secrets/ absent from this copy.

g.aria-label: dj_library.sqlite (ml-store-sqlite) – sqlite at db/dj_library.sqlite; owner build_db; concurrency: full rebuild in a temp dir then shutil.copyfile over the target (copy, not atomic rename); row count and integrity_check afterwards; journal_mode DELETE. Current: 413 tracks, 0 sets, 4 runs, v_review_queue 413.
g.title: dj_library.sqlite (ml-store-sqlite) – sqlite at db/dj_library.sqlite; owner build_db; concurrency: full rebuild in a temp dir then shutil.copyfile over the target (copy, not atomic rename); row count and integrity_check afterwards; journal_mode DELETE.
